LESSON: BELIEVE IN

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.1: Believe in

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Believe in. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Appreciate the importance of the Last 2.0 PILLARS OF IMAN
2. Recognize the power of Allah over everything as a pillar of Iman by Allah. environment so as to appreciate the powers of Allah Core-Competences to be developed: communication and collaboration, imagination and creativity

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Appreciate the importance of the Last 2.0 PILLARS OF IMAN
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of the Last 2.0 PILLARS OF IMAN. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Recognize the power of Allah over everything as a pillar of Iman by Allah. environment so as to appreciate the powers of Allah Core-Competences to be developed: communication and collaboration, imagination and creativity
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recognize the power of Allah over everything as a pillar of Iman by Allah. environment so as to appreciate the powers of Allah Core-Competences to be developed: communication and collaboration, imagination and creativity. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Believe in.
2. Explain Believe in to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Believe in.
4. Show that you can: Appreciate the importance of the Last 2.0 PILLARS OF IMAN
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Believe in. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Believe in important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Appreciate the importance of the Last 2.0 PILLARS OF IMAN
2. Recognize the power of Allah over everything as a pillar of Iman by Allah. environment so as to appreciate the powers of Allah Core-Competences to be developed: communication and collaboration, imagination and creativity

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
